introStart: Hello everybody! It’s Teenagers Round the World Channel. Our guest today is a teenager from Russia and we are going to discuss
introEnd: . We’d like to know our guest’s point of view on this issue. Please answer five questions. So, let’s get started.
finisher: Thank you very much for your interview.

variants.title: Вариант 1
questions: What region of Russia do you live in? Are there any prominent sports teams there?
What else could you tell about your region?
What kinds of sports are popular in Russia? Which aren't?
What kind of sports is your favourite? Why?
Are your friends interested in sports? If so, what kinds of sports?

variants.title: Вариант 2
questions: Could you tell us what is unusual about Russia?
What kinds of hobbies do people usually have in your country?
What is your first hobby? Do you still do it?
How do you spend your free time now?
What hobby would you like to pick up in the future? Why?

variants.title: Вариант 3
questions: How do you get along with your peers?
What are the benefits of friendship?
Where did you meet your best friend? How long have you known each other?
How do you communicate with your friends?
How do you spend time together?
